summary: Institutional positioning is heavily skewed toward long-term bullishness in the broad market, evidenced by massive $1B+ call accumulations in SPX 6000C (exp 2026) and extreme low Put/Call ratios in NVDA (0.18) and AMZN (0.21). Significant directional conviction is visible in the SPXW 8040C and 8050C strikes for late 2026, representing over $560M in single-trade premiums, alongside persistent multi-day buying of SPX 6000C totaling $1.77B. Traders should monitor for continued upward momentum in the semiconductor space (NVDA, MU, AMD) and watch if the massive SPX 6000C/6800C floor holds or if the heavy SPY 660P accumulation signals a long-term hedging hedge.
